svg.title: RealityForge: measure, recover, test, explore, phone composition
svg.desc: A narrow composition of the default hybrid method. After tracking one object, initial observations feed geometry, ParameterNet and physical refinement. A dotted brass route carries remaining observations around the fit to the original-model forecast check. An optional coral branch starts at the recovered model and reruns the same equations with edited parameters. Illustrations are schematic, not measured results.
svg.text: One object · fixed camera · planar scope

g.text: Positions (x, y), times t, confidence w
A conditional prediction, not an experiment.
